run: set -e; mkdir -p '{install_dir}/uv'; tar -xzf '{download}' --strip-components=1 -C '{install_dir}/uv'; UV_CACHE_DIR='{install_dir}/cache' UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR='{install_dir}/python' '{install_dir}/uv/uv' venv '{install_dir}/venv' --python 3.12; UV_CACHE_DIR='{install_dir}/cache' UV_PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR='{install_dir}/python' '{install_dir}/uv/uv' pip install --python '{install_dir}/venv/bin/python' 'max[serve]==26.5.0' 'nvidia-cublas-cu12' 'nvidia-cuda-nvrtc-cu12'; rm -rf '{install_dir}/cache'

list_models.description: List MAX models available on this system by enumerating the HuggingFace cache (models--<owner>--<name> directories that contain a snapshot).
cmd: cd "{models_dir}" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; for d in models--*; do [ -d "$d/snapshots" ] || continue; ls "$d/snapshots" >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; printf '%s\n' "$d" | sed -e 's/^models--//' -e 's/--/\//g'; done

pull_model.description: Download a model into the HuggingFace cache so MAX can serve it (params: {"model": "<owner/name>"}). MAX would fetch it on first launch anyway; doing it here means the download is visible and finishes before the engine is asked to start.

loaded_models.description: List the model MAX is currently serving. MAX serves one model per process, so this returns at most one entry.
